description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans clustering membership table implementation using Redis as the backend store. It defines a test class with various test methods to verify Redis-based membership table operations such as insert, read, update, and cleanup.

classes.name: RedisMembershipTableTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying Redis-backed Orleans membership table operations, including insert, read, update, and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and returns a new LoggerFilterOptions instance for logging configuration.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of RedisMembershipTable configured with Redis connection options.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates and returns a RedisGatewayListProvider for managing gateway list.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Returns the Redis connection string asynchronously.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Test method to verify retrieval of gateways from the membership table.

methods.name: ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Test method to verify reading all entries from an empty membership table.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Test method to verify inserting a row into the membership table.

methods.name: ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Test method to verify reading a row after insertion.

methods.name: ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Test method to verify reading all entries after insertion.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Test method to verify updating a row in the membership table.

methods.name: UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Test method to verify concurrent updates to a row.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Test method to verify updating the 'I am alive' status.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Test method to verify cleanup of defunct silo entries.
